source.title: Severe Necrotizing Fasciitis in a Human Immunodeficiency Virus-Positive Patient Caused by Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus

extraction_limitations: Single-patient case report; no comparator arm or inferential statistical design.

The current LiteratureAtom schema is exposure/outcome oriented and has no dedicated case-observation or antimicrobial-susceptibility atom kind; isolate MICs are therefore represented as atom_kind=other rather than forced into quantitative_result.
The literature-review counts in the article are secondary summaries; underlying cited studies were not re-atomized as if they were primary data from this report.
No unsupported study details were added; missing denominators, uncertainty estimates, or causal attribution remain missing.
